terminals.name: neon-proxy
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; cd /workspace; for i in $(seq 1 90); do [ -x scripts/cloud-agent/run-neon-proxy.sh ] && break; sleep 1; done; bash scripts/cloud-agent/run-neon-proxy.sh
terminals.description: Neon local WebSocket proxy on 5433, tunneling to local Postgres on 5432. Warm-fork checkouts wait until the script lands. App writes still follow injected DATABASE_URL.

terminals.name: dev
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; cd /workspace; for i in $(seq 1 90); do [ -x scripts/cloud-agent/run-dev.sh ] && break; sleep 1; done; export BETTER_AUTH_URL="${BETTER_AUTH_URL:-http://localhost:3000}"; export CORS_ORIGIN="${CORS_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3001}"; export VITE_SERVER_URL="${VITE_SERVER_URL:-http://localhost:3000}"; export NODE_ENV="${NODE_ENV:-development}"; bash scripts/cloud-agent/run-dev.sh
terminals.description: Turborepo dev servers: web (http://localhost:3001), API server (http://localhost:3000), and Fumadocs (http://localhost:4000). App writes follow injected DATABASE_URL.
